change: local external-action approval events invalidate previous acceptance on success, errors and cancellation
manifest_format: LF-normalized SHA256 of compact ASCII JSON [relative_path,file_sha256] rows sorted by path, immediate Python files only.

reproduction.scope: Initial harness before production edits. Final tests additionally cover checkpoint callback failure and owner read-id invalidation; not a byte-identical pre/post benchmark.

local_suites.command: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv-wsl uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -q

compatibility_suites.command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv-py311 uv run --locked --python 3.11 --no-editable python -m unittest tests.test_local_actions tests.test_lsp.LspChatTests tests.test_mcp_stdio tests.test_jobs tests.test_worktrees tests.test_acceptance_chat -q

legacy_test_update: Full suite found three legacy fixtures that fabricated approved=true or interrupted execution without an actual approval. Replaced them with real disposable Git commands and actual approvals, disabled system/global Git config in those fixtures, preserved output privacy and cancellation assertions, and revalidated the final test tree.

installed_wheel.scope: Copied tests/fixtures in a disposable directory, isolated -I/-B child with installed package first. All imported sprig_agent modules checked to reside in the installed target. No repository src path is available in that disposable directory.

tested_behaviors: MCP stdio peer creates a file then waits; actual CLI cancellation kills the owned peer, retains private uncertainty notice and continues without replay.
Real background process creates a file; injected post-start result failure cannot leave CLI status 0 or omit the notice.
Background stop control failure records actual fresh approval; no lost success state in CLI/TUI.
Git/worktree cancellation in the approval callback, before approval, does not invent a side-effect notice.
Four real worktree approvals create one checkout and one notice, with old owner read_id invalidated.
MCP local status, background list and declined connection do not add notices or create processes.
Actual TUI runs a background command, then fixed independent acceptance, then freshly approves stop. Control failure invalidates the earlier result.
TUI checkpoint callback failure settles the operation with error, leaves task unverified, retains notice in memory and does not claim disk was updated.
Local command output and checkout target are absent from uploaded history; explicit continue sees only a fixed uncertainty notice.

upstream_read.scope: assert/Deferred waiting, declined errors and pending cleanup reread; no upstream executable or tests run, no allow/always copied.

other_checks: uv run --locked python -m compileall -q src tests scripts
uv build --wheel and isolated installed regression suite

remote_ci.resume_rule: Verify account restriction and prior required gate before resuming CI-enabled batches; the date alone is insufficient.

limitations: Local Windows/WSL results do not replace native CI runners, macOS or the full Python matrix. Skips are not passes.
Post-start result/control/checkpoint faults are injected after actual process or UI work; these are robustness evidence, not model coding success or general failure-rate measurements.
Approved programs retain current-user authority; no OS sandbox, automatic rollback, file watcher, command snapshot or crash recovery of side effects is added.
Runtime snapshots still describe the last model run; they cannot override task invalidation after local operations.
CLI legacy operation error/cancellation exit codes remain; this batch unifies actual-approval invalidation and privacy, not every local-result status semantic.
No mini client rerun: client code and model transport were not changed; no new client or model performance claim.
